about: The suggested minimum base price for each chain, in GRT per 30 days. These are the figures
shown commented out under [dips.min_grt_per_30_days] in maximal-config-example.toml, and a
test in this crate fails if the 2 disagree.
Dipper, the service that offers indexing agreements to indexers, reads this file from
GitHub while it runs and sets its price ceilings from it: by default it leaves out of
selection any indexer whose base price is more than a fixed multiple of the figure for the
chain. So a change merged here changes what dipper will accept within hours of merging.
Dipper fetches the file by its branch and path: moving or renaming it, or leaving it out of
a rebuilt branch, stops dipper following it until dipper's own address changes too.
Dipper keeps the figures it had, and raises an alert, when a version of this file lists no
chain, lists a chain twice, holds anything but positive numbers, or holds a figure high
enough to put a ceiling above dipper's cap on an agreement. A dipper that is already running
also refuses a version that drops a chain, moves a figure by more than 10 times, or adds a
chain above the highest figure or below a tenth of the lowest.
A dipper that has just started applies only the first set, so it takes a mistake such as
4,500 in place of 450 as published: review a change here as if nothing will catch it. By
default the highest figure also sets dipper's ceiling for every chain this file does not list.
